description: This Java class implements a DialogHelper interface to facilitate showing dialogs within an Android activity, specifically handling exception dialogs with customizable titles and messages.

classes.name: DialogHelperImpl
classes.description: A class that manages dialog display, especially exception dialogs, within an Android activity.

methods.name: showErrorMessageDialog
methods.description: Displays an error message dialog with a title and exception details.

methods.name: handleOnCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates dialog instances based on dialog ID and arguments, primarily for exception display.

methods.name: convertExceptionToErrorMessage
methods.description: Converts an exception into a user-readable error message string.
